 Publications at top-tier conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS) specifically focusing on robotic manipulation, grasping, or contact-rich RL.

 
 Demonstrated experience working with tactile sensing, multi-fingered robotic hands, or bimanual manipulation.
